messages:
anna_docs: Heads-up — I'm opening a small PR that adds a concise 're-provision playbook' for sealed-site/offline installs. It's a single-page checklist + a tiny example of the CLI steps for reprovisioning nodes with KMS/HSM fallback. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 :white_check_mark:
sam_infra: linking in. can you paste the minimal command example here so reviewers don't need to jump to the branch?
anna_docs: sure — example command (airgapped):
```
# on bastion
./rwinctl installer reprovision --bundle ./offline-bundle.tar.gz \
  --inventory ./sealed-inventory.yaml \
  --kms-endpoint file:///var/run/kms-proxy.sock \
  --hsm-mode fallback
```
maria_security: Quick Q — for HSM fallback, do we explicitly mention that we expect PKCS#11 path to be present on the node? Might save three back-and-forths in support tickets.
anna_docs: good point. I added a one-line note under "HSM fallback behavior": "Ensure pkcs11 plugin is installed and socket path matches inventory pkcs11_path (e.g. /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so)."
nick_eng: Can we also include the small systemd unit snippet for kms-proxy in the playbook? folks often forget to enable it in sealed networks.
anna_docs: added a minimal systemd example in the PR:
```
[Unit]
Description=rw-kms-proxy
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/rw-kms-proxy --socket /var/run/kms-proxy.sock --backend /opt/hsm
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
sam_infra: nit: under networking preflight, can we call out MTU=1400 for some HW NAT setups? I hit an install failure with jumbo frames last week.
anna_docs: added a short sentence: "If your edge NAT or load-balancer uses jumbo frames, consider MTU 1400 in installer profile to avoid fragmented TLS handshakes."
maria_security: also added a short policy blurb: "When using KMS proxy with on-prem HSM, ensure KMS credentials are stored in the node KMS secret store and rotated per org policy; do not embed keys in inventory."
nick_eng: LGTM for content. small doc request: can we include an optional troubleshooting command for checking PKCS#11 availability?
anna_docs: included: `p11tool --list-modules` and `softhsm2-util --show-slots` examples.
sam_infra: one more: can we add a tiny paragraph describing expected error messages from rwinctl reprovision when the HSM socket is missing? We get repeated support pings for that exact message.
anna_docs: done — included the exact stderr snippet: `error connecting to pkcs11 socket: dial unix /var/run/hsm.sock: connect: no such file or directory` and recommended action.
deploy-bot: CI status — PR #4123 checks: build docs: success, linkcheck: failed (1 broken link)
anna_docs: ack. I'll fix the broken anchor — it was an internal anchor that got renamed during the Installer API doc tidy.
anna_docs: pushed a tiny commit to fix the anchor and added a quick test note for maintainers: "When renaming headings, run `make linkcheck` locally."
sam_infra: Can we slot someone from eng to sanity-check the command flags? Nick?
nick_eng: checked the flags quickly — `--hsm-mode fallback` is correct and maps to runtime 'soft-fallback' behavior. One suggestion: change `--kms-endpoint` example to `unix:///var/run/kms-proxy.sock` to match runtime URI parsing.
anna_docs: updated example text to `unix:///var/run/kms-proxy.sock` and updated the PR summary.
maria_security: approved from security side (quick read).
sam_infra: approved from infra.
nick_eng: approved from eng.
anna_docs: thanks all — merging after the final linkcheck completes. leaving a tiny post-merge follow-up step in the doc: "After merge, backport the playbook to stable-2.1 branch."
deploy-bot: CI status — linkcheck: success. PR merged by anna_docs. :tada:
